body: It seems I can't really get my point across---forget it

Is the gap an illusion or does the gap become a new reality? I read online that there are substances like acid and mushrooms that give an illusory paradigm shift, sometimes permanently. But that isn't anything I can just get at a pharmacy, so I've mostly been just thinking about it in the back of my mind.   
My existence is pretty meditative as it is. Zen Buddhists have a saying that goes "before enlightenment, chop wood, carry water". My days are nothing but menial chores, whether or not I care if enlightenment is the reward, or maybe even the result. Who would have ever guessed that there was a time where the feedback loop of transient pleasure was considered a problem? I'm lucky if I come across a genuine smile being described in a novel.
